name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
label: Quest
description: The Remains of Trey Lightforge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of Felwood and Ashenvale. Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How did things go in Jaedenar, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it! Praise be to Elune and whichever powers you worship, friend. You have done an honorable and noble thing this day. I am certain Arko'narin will be pleased that you not only took the time to save her, but to also slay the creature who tortured one of her best friends.
I wish I could do more for you, but please, take this.
